name: com.timbojimbo.ui.text
description: A UGUI text component rendered by Unity's Advanced Text Generator: HarfBuzz shaping, ICU line breaking and bidi, OS font fallback and colour emoji, with no native plugins. Markdown, font stacks and inline prefabs; backgrounds drawn with the UI package's Box.

samples.description: A chat feed with a theme, an emote set (:smile:), a mention chip (@name) with a nested TextBlock, a monospace font stack for code and a scene.
